rules.crossPlatformLockstep: Mac + Windows + Web REQUIRED or justified N/A per shared G1 scope
rules.closureRule: A version/band cannot close while an applicable row is unassigned, unexplained, unevidenced or silently carried forward.

requirements.requirement: Provider legal/data-rights metadata covers commercial/multi-user, proxying, caching/retention, redistribution/display, derived/AI use, limits, attribution, environment and effective/expiry/renewal state.
Provider-specific rights evidence is bound, reviewable, provenance-linked and never inferred from a working key/public endpoint.
Rights decisions fail closed and deterministically enforce downgrade/expiry across routing, cache/persistence eligibility and later hosted serving/live fan-out without creating a second router.
requirements.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router v2 + canonical cache/persistence + provider rights decision owner

requirements.requirement: First-class tenant/account ownership context and isolation boundary exists independently of role, product entitlement and provider rights.
Canonical role/capability truth SUPER_OWNER/OWNER/ADMIN/USER/DEMO is preserved for hosted authorization; ADMIN remains capability-scoped.
Device registration, naming, attribution, last-seen, revoke/lost/stale retirement and immediate network denial are canonical and auditable.
Session expiry/refresh/revocation, sensitive-action re-authentication and stronger MFA/passkey-class controls are canonical across API/UI/streams.
DE.PULSE product plan/status and feature/capability entitlement are separate from RBAC and provider rights and enforced before restricted serving.
Quota dimensions, metering truth, grace/suspension/disabled behavior and deterministic plan upgrade/downgrade transitions are product-owned.
Account data inventory/classification, purpose/consumer, minimization and retention rules exist by data class.
Account/user review/export/portability, deactivation/deletion and durable tombstone semantics are executable across product-owned account data.

Deletion/expiry semantics cover PostgreSQL, sync logs, native SQLite, cache, backups/PITR; audit/log retention, operator access and residency are explicit and compatible with provider/legal retention constraints.
Dev/test/stage/prod are isolated with versioned IaC/desired state, environment-specific configuration and drift detection; production is not a snowflake.
Service-to-service identity, ingress/egress/network/TLS trust boundaries and least privilege are explicit and reproducible.

PostgreSQL tenant schema, ownership, migrations, expand/contract strategy and defense-in-depth RLS disposition are canonical; PostgreSQL is shared hosted authority only for sync-eligible lawful state.
PostgreSQL pool/index/capacity limits, HA/failover, encrypted backup, PITR, restore drills, RPO/RTO, partial-outage and rollback-reconciliation behavior are proven.
Hosted provider secrets use server-side managed-secret/KMS ownership, versioned references and least-privilege resolution; zero raw provider secrets reach normal clients or sync rows.
requirements.canonicalOwner: canonical server managed-secret/KMS owner + existing local secret owner for standalone mode

requirements.requirement: Secret rotation, staged cutover/rollback, emergency revoke, health-before-cutover, environment isolation, audit and no-secret logs/traces/backups are proven.
Direct/transitive dependency inventory, vulnerability/advisory scanning, SBOM where applicable, license/source policy and approved dependency sources are executable.
Build/deploy artifact integrity, signing/attestation/provenance, source→build→artifact→environment traceability and vulnerable-component patch/revoke process are executable.
Provider quality/cost/coverage/SLO scorecards use measured health/freshness/latency/disagreement/headroom/rights/cost/usefulness without changing deterministic routing authority.
requirements.canonicalOwner: Smart Router diagnostics + provider usefulness/Data Health owners

requirements.requirement: Canonical revision/reconciliation/point-in-time quality primitives distinguish source time, observed time, revision/amendment and no-lookahead truth.
v19.0 foundation has zero unexplained applicable requirement carry-forward before gateway activation; all rows through HOST-022 are evidenced or explicitly blocked by a named external dependency.

Hosted Provider Gateway exposes authenticated versioned REST/snapshot boundary around existing canonical provider owners; commercial users remain zero-key and no client silently falls back to platform keys.
requirements.canonicalOwner: hosted gateway around Smart Provider Router v2

requirements.requirement: Canonical serving decision composes tenant/account → session/device → RBAC/capability → product entitlement → provider rights → freshness/data-class before projection/provider need.
requirements.canonicalOwner: hosted serving-policy owner consuming canonical authorization/rights/freshness owners

requirements.requirement: Cache/persistence lookup, single-flight/coalescing and cross-user reuse are entitlement/right/data-class safe; higher entitlement never leaks to lower entitlement.
Existing multi-feed subscription owner is reused server-side for lawful shared upstream live subscriptions and authorized downstream WebSocket/SSE fan-out; no second subscription manager.
Role/capability/product-plan/provider-right/session/device changes promptly terminate or re-authorize long-lived hosted streams.
Hosted API/stream inventory, schema/protocol versioning, compatibility matrix, deprecation/removal policy and truthful unsupported-client behavior are explicit.

SQLite applies eligible local mutation + durable outbox intent atomically; typed mutation envelope carries stable entity, tenant/user/device, base revision, schema/protocol version and idempotency key.
Server validates auth/tenant/RBAC/product entitlement/rights/schema/mutation semantics, applies idempotently and transactionally to PostgreSQL, and records authoritative revision/change sequence.
Clients pull after durable per-device checkpoint, apply idempotently/transactionally to SQLite, and advance checkpoint only after durable apply; retries cannot duplicate semantic writes.
New devices bootstrap from consistent tenant/account snapshot/page stream plus high-watermark, transactional local apply and delta continuation without deleting unrelated local state.
Checkpoint expiry, change-log/tombstone retention/compaction, inactive-device retirement and stale-device re-bootstrap are deterministic; deletion is never inferred from absence after compaction.

Sync domains use stable IDs, revision/version semantics, server change metadata, deterministic conflict/delete/tombstone rules and domain-appropriate conflict preservation; client wall-clock is never sole authority.
requirements.canonicalOwner: sync conflict policy framework + domain canonical owners

requirements.requirement: Native SQLite is strictly tenant/account scoped; sign-out/user switch cannot expose another account; lost/revoked device behavior and retained-local-data policy follow threat model/privacy lifecycle.
Sync uses bounded batches, retry+jitter/backpressure, selective domains and yields/preempts/checkpoints before protected Tier-0 market sessions degrade.
requirements.canonicalOwner: sync scheduler + canonical runtime/provider budget owners
